hero.title: Get in <accent>touch.</accent>
hero.text: Céline Bossé, RD, public health dietitian for the Calgary region. An email or a phone call is all it takes to get started.

prepare.title: What to include in your email
prepare.text: A few details help me suggest the right workshop for your group.

steps.title: Your organization
steps.text: School, daycare, community organization, seniors’ group or employer.

steps.title: Your group
steps.text: The number of participants and their ages.

steps.title: Your dates
steps.text: Preferred dates or time frame, and the location.

steps.title: The topic
steps.text: Cinq Épices workshop, community kitchen, health promotion, Lunch & Learn or another subject.

area.title: Calgary and Southern Alberta
area.text: In person at your location, or through a virtual grocery store tour.

cta.title: I look forward to hearing from you.
cta.text: Not sure which format yet? Browse the services to find the idea that suits you.
